families.name: CATALYST_EXTREME_ACTIVITY_CONTINUATION_OR_REVERSAL
families.mechanism: At 10:00 ET (30 minutes post-open -- enough regular-session information exists to measure the activity condition causally, while remaining clearly an activity/catalyst trigger, not a late-day setup), compute (a) overnight gap magnitude: gap_pct = (today_open - prior_close)/prior_close*100, and (b) relative activity: RVOL = cumulative 09:30-10:00 volume today / causal trailing-10-day average of the SAME 09:30-10:00 volume window (prior days only, today excluded). An extreme session requires BOTH abs(gap_pct) and RVOL to clear a combined band. Two hypotheses tested SEPARATELY (not pooled): CONTINUATION (bet direction = sign(gap)) and REVERSAL (bet direction = -sign(gap)).
families.provider_note: RVOL is volume-based -> PROVIDER_SENSITIVE (SIP research vs IEX live volume mismatch risk). gap_pct alone is price-only and portable, but was NOT separately gridded in Task74B (budget discipline) -- recorded as a deferred idea for Task75+, not silently added here.

families.name: MULTIDAY_CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_OR_REVERSAL
families.mechanism: On a completed session (Day0 close), compute each symbol's market-adjusted 3-trading-day cumulative displacement: (stock's 3-day cum return) - (SPY's 3-day cum return), using only information complete as of Day0 close (causal). Rank cross-sectionally among the universe symbols with valid data that day. Two hypotheses tested SEPARATELY: MOMENTUM (bet WITH the extreme -- LONG top rank, SHORT bottom rank) and REVERSAL (bet AGAINST the extreme -- SHORT top rank, LONG bottom rank). Materially different from the rejected IDIOSYNCRATIC_RESIDUAL_MOMENTUM_LONG_V1: multi-session (not single-session) displacement, cross-sectional rank (not a beta-residual), multi-day holding (not intraday), and both directions/both hypotheses genuinely tested rather than assuming LONG-only.
families.decision_point: Day0 close (after the session is complete)
families.risk_semantics: NO optimized stop in Task74B -- fixed-horizon-only discovery first, per instruction. MFE/MAE and overnight-gap risk recorded for any near-promotion cell. No synthetic daily bars; horizon exits bounded by each slice's actual last trading day (NO_VALID_EXIT rejection if the required forward session does not exist within the slice).
